title: NTA UGC NET December 2023 E Certificate
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ugcnet.nta.nic.in
2. e-Certificate download section
3. Login with December 2023 credentials
4. Download certificate
5. Use for teaching job applications
shortDescription: NTA UGC NET December 2023 E-Certificate – download from ugcnet.nta.nic.in for qualified candidates.
content: Candidates who qualified UGC NET December 2023 can still download their e-certificates from the NTA portal if the link remains active, or retrieve them via DigiLocker.
